fr_soulever_verb.hook: Up it goes! Monsieur Verbe LIFTS the heavy suitcase high – a real LEVER job (soo-luh-VAY).
fr_soulever_verb.why: Lever = to raise → soulever = to lift (something heavy). Regular -er (je soulève): RED beret.

fr_dresser_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe pulls the rope and the tent stands UP straight – he DRESSES it up (dray-SAY).
fr_dresser_verb.why: Dress (a line, straighten up) → dresser = to put up, to set up (a tent, a table). Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_elever_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe RAISES hens and chicks – up, up they grow, like an ELEVATOR (eh-luh-VAY).
fr_elever_verb.why: Elevate → élever = to raise (animals, children), to lift. Regular -er (j'élève): RED beret.

fr_augmenter_verb.hook: One more coin and the stack grows taller – it INCREASES, it is AUGMENTED (ohg-mahn-TAY).
fr_augmenter_verb.why: Augment → augmenter = to increase, to go up. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_baisser_verb.hook: Too loud! Monsieur Verbe turns the music DOWN – down to the BASS (bay-SAY).
fr_baisser_verb.why: Bas = low → baisser = to lower, to turn down. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_depasser_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe PASSES the tortoise on his bike – he OVERTAKES it (day-pah-SAY).
fr_depasser_verb.why: Passer = to pass → dépasser = to overtake, to go beyond. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_reduire_verb.hook: Crunch! Monsieur Verbe REDUCES the big can to a small flat disc (ray-DWEER).
fr_reduire_verb.why: Reduce → réduire = to reduce, to cut down. Irregular (je réduis, nous réduisons, réduit): GOLD beret.

fr_grandir_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe stretches tall beside the sunflower – they both GROW, they get GRAND (grahn-DEER).
fr_grandir_verb.why: Grand = big, tall → grandir = to grow (up). Regular -ir (nous …issons): GREEN beret.

fr_transformer_verb.hook: A wave of the magic wand and the pumpkin will TRANSFORM into a carriage (trahns-for-MAY).
fr_transformer_verb.why: Transform → transformer = to transform, to change. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_atteindre_verb.hook: On tiptoe, Monsieur Verbe just REACHES the apple – he ATTAINS it (ah-TANDR).
fr_atteindre_verb.why: Attain → atteindre = to reach, to attain. Irregular (j'atteins, atteint): GOLD beret.

fr_adapter_verb.hook: Snow! Monsieur Verbe ADAPTS at once – woolly scarf on, check in the hand mirror: s'adapter (ah-dahp-TAY).
fr_adapter_verb.why: Adapt → s'adapter = to adapt (to), to adjust. The hand mirror shows it is reflexive (s'). Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_varier_verb.hook: Every scoop a different colour – Monsieur Verbe likes to VARY his flavours (vah-RYAY).
fr_varier_verb.why: Vary → varier = to vary, to change. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_devenir_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe gazes at the helmet: one day he will BECOME a firefighter – DE-VENIR, 'come to be' (duh-vuh-NEER).
fr_devenir_verb.why: Venir = to come → devenir = to become. Irregular like venir (je deviens, devenu): GOLD beret.

fr_accomplir_verb.hook: The very last piece – Monsieur Verbe has ACCOMPLISHED the whole puzzle (ah-kohn-PLEER).
fr_accomplir_verb.why: Accomplish → accomplir = to accomplish, to carry out. Regular -ir (nous …issons): GREEN beret.

fr_remplacer_verb.hook: Up the ladder, Monsieur Verbe REPLACES the old bulb – a new one in its PLACE (rahn-plah-SAY).
fr_remplacer_verb.why: Replace → remplacer = to replace. Regular -er (nous remplaçons): RED beret.

fr_evoluer_verb.hook: Tadpole, froglet, frog: Monsieur Verbe points at how it EVOLVES (ay-voh-LWAY).
fr_evoluer_verb.why: Evolve → évoluer = to evolve, to change, to develop. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_refaire_verb.hook: The sandcastle fell down, so Monsieur Verbe MAKES it AGAIN – RE-FAIRE, re-do (ruh-FEHR).
fr_refaire_verb.why: Re + faire (to make, to do) → refaire = to redo, to make again. Irregular like faire: GOLD beret.

fr_reussir_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe leaps with his trophy – he SUCCEEDED (ray-ew-SEER)!
fr_reussir_verb.why: réussir = to succeed, to pass (an exam); une réussite = a success. Regular -ir (nous …issons): GREEN beret.

fr_ajouter_verb.hook: A pinch more salt: Monsieur Verbe ADDS it to the soup – AJOUTER sounds like 'a-JOT-ay', add a jot (ah-zhoo-TAY).
fr_ajouter_verb.why: ajouter = to add. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_renvoyer_verb.hook: Thwack! Monsieur Verbe SENDS the ball BACK over the net – RE + ENVOY, sent back (rahn-vwah-YAY).
fr_renvoyer_verb.why: Envoyer = to send → renvoyer = to send back, to return. Irregular like envoyer (je renverrai): GOLD beret.

fr_recommencer_verb.hook: Crumple, toss – Monsieur Verbe STARTS AGAIN on a fresh sheet: RE-COMMENCE (ruh-koh-mahn-SAY).
fr_recommencer_verb.why: Re + commencer → recommencer = to start again. Regular -er (nous recommençons): RED beret.

fr_commencer_verb.hook: On your marks… Monsieur Verbe is ready to START, to COMMENCE the race (koh-mahn-SAY)!
fr_commencer_verb.why: Commence → commencer = to begin, to start. Regular -er (nous commençons): RED beret.

fr_cesser_verb.hook: The rain has CEASED – Monsieur Verbe closes his umbrella and smiles (say-SAY).
fr_cesser_verb.why: Cease → cesser = to stop, to cease. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_repeter_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe speaks, and the parrot REPEATS every word (ray-pay-TAY).
fr_repeter_verb.why: Repeat → répéter = to repeat; also to rehearse. Regular -er (je répète): RED beret.

fr_arreter_verb.hook: Screech! Monsieur Verbe STOPS his scooter dead – ARREST! The hand mirror says s'arrêter (ah-ray-TAY).
fr_arreter_verb.why: Arrest (bring to a halt) → s'arrêter = to stop (oneself). The hand mirror shows it is reflexive (s'). Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_empecher_verb.hook: Hand over his mouth, Monsieur Verbe tries to IMPEACH his own giggle – but he can't help it! The hand mirror says s'empêcher (ahn-pay-SHAY).
fr_empecher_verb.why: Impede, impeach → empêcher = to prevent; s'empêcher de = to stop oneself, to help doing. The hand mirror shows it is reflexive (s'). Regular -er: RED beret.
ex: Il ne peut pas s'empêcher de rire.

fr_continuer_verb.hook: Straight on! Monsieur Verbe CONTINUES along the winding path (kohn-tee-NWAY).
fr_continuer_verb.why: Continue → continuer = to continue, to keep going. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_terminer_verb.hook: The cherry on top – the cake is TERMINATED, all done (tehr-mee-NAY)!
fr_terminer_verb.why: Terminate → terminer = to finish, to end. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_finir_verb.hook: Arms up through the ribbon: Monsieur Verbe FINISHES the race (fee-NEER)!
fr_finir_verb.why: Finish → finir = to finish, to end. Regular -ir (nous …issons): GREEN beret.

fr_achever_verb.hook: One last stroke and Monsieur Verbe ACHIEVES his painting – it is complete (ah-shuh-VAY).
fr_achever_verb.why: Achieve ≈ achever, which means to complete, to finish off. Regular -er (j'achève): RED beret.
